en: The Dyad on Roots to be Abandoned by Seeing.

Dependent on a state whose root is to be abandoned by insight (*dassanena pahātabba-hetuka*), a state whose root is to be abandoned by insight arises by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*) ... three.
Dependent on a state whose root is not to be abandoned by insight (*na-dassanena pahātabba-hetuka*), a state whose root is not to be abandoned by insight arises by way of root-condition ... three.

Dependent on a state whose root is both to be abandoned by insight and not to be abandoned by insight, a state whose root is to be abandoned by insight arises by way of root-condition ... three. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to cause, nine; with respect to object, six; with respect to predominance, five …pe… with respect to result, one …pe… with respect to non-disappearance, nine.
